description: Proposed vehicle access; hard landscaping; parking
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">K102602-K10-XX-XX-D-A-0100
REV P02, Design and Access Statement, Reasonable Exception Form, Location Plan&nbsp;</span>

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed hardstanding/permeable paving adjacent to the root protection area of the mature tree at 15 &amp; 17 Summit Close shall comprise a no dig base, and all work within root protection area must be undertaken using hand tools only to ensure no damage occurs to the root protection area of the mature tree.&nbsp;</p>

Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.
Please note: guidance on permeable paving has now been published by the Environment Agency on http://www.communities.gov.uk/publications/planningandbuilding/pavingfrontgardens.
